result.title: An Early Preview of AI Agent Workflows on NVIDIA RTX Spark Laptops
result.description:
See how NVIDIA RTX Spark laptops accelerate advanced local AI and agentic workflows. Featuring up to 128GB of unified memory, these systems enable creators to run large models entirely on-device. Watch as the OpenClaw personal agent automates complex ComfyUI tasks, managing prompts and hyperparameters to seamlessly transform a concept sketch from Adobe Photoshop into a fully animated video while keeping your data private and secure.

Learn more: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/rtx-spark/

result.title: How NPS and NVIDIA Are Training the Next AI Leaders
result.description:
Discover how NVIDIA is collaborating with the Naval Postgraduate School (NPS) to empower thousands of students to work and build applications with AI.

Todd Lyons, EVP at the Naval Postgraduate School Foundation, details how NPS is utilizing NVIDIA DGX and NVIDIA Omniverse technologies to create synthetic data, train foundational models, and deploy solutions at scale for the public sector.

Learn more about the NPS and NVIDIA partnership at Converge @ NPS: https://www.npsfoundation.org/partners/convergenps

result.title: BIO Conference with Kimberly Powell
result.description:
Walk the #BIO2026 show floor with Kimberly Powell, NVIDIA VP of Healthcare, as she shares what’s exciting about the latest BioNeMo toolkit announcement. 

BioNeMo is helping bring AI-driven biology and drug discovery closer to the next experiment, with tools for researchers and developers to build, customize and deploy AI applications across the life sciences ecosystem.

Read more about the announcement: https://nvda.ws/4f1J3BV
